description: Use this for what changed: with a slug, the timeline of one product; without, the feed across the catalog since a date, filtered by change type (price_drop, new_integration, ...) or category. A research_update is a change to OUR knowledge (unknown, estimated), never to the product.

include_minor.description: Include changes that are not material.

slug.description: A product slug for its own timeline. Omit for the catalog-wide feed.

statement_id.description: Feed only: the stable statement id from a product attribute. Includes corrections and withdrawals.

types.description: Feed only: change types to include. Known: price_drop, price_increase, new_price, new_product, new_ai_agent, new_integration, new_alternative, security_certification, product_change, documented, research_update, funding, acquisition, source_changed.

name: get_product_changes
title: Changes to products and prices
